description: This file declares utility functions related to tensor shape manipulations, strides, and dimension operations within the torch::lazy namespace, primarily for internal use in the PyTorch lazy execution framework.

methods.name: StrideIsSupported
methods.description: Checks if the given stride array is supported for tensor operations.

methods.name: GetArrayStridePermutation
methods.description: Returns a permutation of the stride array.

methods.name: MakeDiagonalShape
methods.description: Creates a shape representing a diagonal tensor with given offset and dimensions.

methods.name: MakePermuteShape
methods.description: Creates a permuted shape based on a source shape and permutation order.

methods.name: MakeSelectShape
methods.description: Creates a shape for a tensor slice defined by start, end, and stride along a specific dimension.

methods.name: GetStride
methods.description: Calculates the stride value based on start, end, and stride parameters.

methods.name: BuildSqueezedDimensions
methods.description: Generates squeezed dimensions based on the provided dimensions and the dimension to squeeze.

methods.name: BuildUnsqueezedDimensions
methods.description: Generates unsqueezed dimensions based on the provided dimensions and the dimension to unsqueeze.
